# Downstream screenshot fixtures

Stand-in homepage screenshots for the downstream examples stories, served by
Storybook at `/fixtures/downstream/`.

- The sites (Atelier, Blake & Co., Principio) are invented design mockups, not
  real downstream projects.
- Their shapes differ on purpose, so the stories show the section copes with
  any screenshot: `atelier.webp` is a full-page capture (1024×1536),
  `blake-and-co.webp` its first screen at 16:10 (1024×640) and
  `principio.webp` at 4:3 (1024×768).
